programme.title: Tous les chemins mènent à Rome
programme.desc: Une mère de famille un peu à cran, se voit partir en road trip en Italie avec son amour de jeunesse Italien, afin de rattraper sa fille rebelle, qui souhaite rejoindre New-York à tout prix.

programme.title: La Fille du Président
programme.desc: La fille du Président des Etats-Unis insiste pour suivre une scolarité normale, sans la surveillance des services secrets. Un agent se fait donc passer pour un étudiant afin de la protéger.

programme.title: Une nouvelle chance (2016)
programme.desc: Un avenir de jeune chef tendait les bras à Charlie. Pourtant sa vie semble s'être suspendue, habitant avec sa mère et son beau-père et travaillant dans le cinéma de son quartier, Charlie n'a plus de motivation pour rien...

programme.title: Kill Me Later
programme.desc: Un homme en fuite pour sauver sa peau rencontre une femme qui veut mettre fin à ses jours. Ils passent un marché : "Aide-moi maintenant et je te tuerai plus tard." C'est ainsi que commence une course pour leur survie à tous deux.

programme.title: L'Amour à la dérive
programme.desc: Lors d'une croisière dans les Caraïbes, Jenny est abandonnée sur une plage avec son idole du rock and roll. Délireusement amoureuse de l'idée de passer du temps seule avec lui, elle parvient à cacher le fait qu'ils sont à deux pas de leur station balnéaire.

programme.title: Après Lucia
programme.desc: Lucia est morte dans un accident de voiture il y a six mois depuis, son mari Roberto et sa fille Alejandra, tentent de surmonter ce deuil. Afin de prendre un nouveau départ, Roberto décide de s'installer à Mexico. Alejandra se retrouve, nouvelle, dans une classe. Plus jolie, plus brillante, elle est rapidement la cible d'envie et de jalousie de la part de ses camarades. Refusant d'en parler à son père, elle devient une proie, un bouc émissaire.

programme.title: L'Aventure du Dr Fergus
programme.desc: Comédie sur un dentiste américain (Daniel Day-Lewis) parcourant la campagne argentine à moto pour prêcher l'évangile de l'hygiène dentaire.

programme.title: La vie de bohème
programme.desc: Tous sont des artistes (peintres, musiciens, poètes...), tous sont destinés à la gloire, ce sont les beaux jours, la jeunesse. C'est La Vie De Bohême, la vie bohémienne. Mimi et Rodolphe se promènent dans les Jardins du Luxembourg. C'est le printemps. L'été apporte la Révolution de 1848. Rodolphe, le poète, est très déçu car personne ne veut publier ses vers. L'automne marque le début des mauvais jours. Les amis n'ont rien à brûler dans leur cheminée sauf eux-mêmes. Mimi a quitté Rodolphe car elle ne veut pas être un fardeau pour lui. En hiver, alors que la neige tombe, les amis fêtent Noël Mimi est devenue une femme entretenue elle est mourante et elle est toujours amoureuse de Rodolphe.

programme.title: Golem, le Tueur de Londres
programme.desc: Le Londres victorien est terrorisé par un tueur en série inconnu qui laisse des messages énigmatiques écrits avec le sang de ses victimes. Lorsque les meurtres se multiplient, Scotland Yard confie l'affaire à un inspecteur célèbre.

programme.title: The Neighbor
programme.desc: Un homme d'âge moyen voit sa vie bouleversée par une jolie jeune femme.

programme.title: Accélération
programme.desc: Vladik Zorich, un seigneur du crime vicieux, est doublé par son agent le plus fiable, Rhona.

programme.title: Dans la Tête d'Alan Moore
programme.desc: La vie d'une légende de la BD et de la contre-culture.

programme.title: Par Amour
programme.desc: Dans un cours de théâtre, l'amour sera vécu aussi fort que l'histoire de la pièce de Shakespeare.

programme.title: Walt Avant Mickey
programme.desc: Walt Disney surmonte les obstacles de son enfance, créant Mickey Mouse et un empire légendaire.

programme.title: L'amour en cuisine
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un chef de restaurant n'est pas éligible à une promotion, elle essaie de gagner la confiance de son patron en pariant qu'elle peut transformer le pire restaurant de la ville et commence à tomber amoureuse du propriétaire.

programme.title: L'amour à chaque seconde
programme.desc: Stéphanie hérite d'une montre capable de remonter le temps de cinq minutes par jour. Mais en voulant améliorer sa vie et sa romance avec Hunter, elle provoque des conséquences inattendues.

programme.title: Une romance entre les lignes
programme.desc: Ivy, éditrice de romances ambitieuse, aide un auteur de polars à intégrer plus d'amour dans son roman. Lorsqu'il devient son faux cavalier pour un mariage sur la plage, la fiction commence à ressembler à la réalité.

programme.title: Un Noël créatif
programme.desc: Harper, illustratrice en herbe, aide un auteur célèbre mais en panne d'inspiration dans une petite ville du Colorado pendant Noël. Entre créativité et festivités, une romance inattendue naît peu à peu.

programme.title: Pour Le Pire Et Pour Le Meilleur
programme.desc: Melvin Udall, un écrivain misanthrope, écrit à la chaîne des romans sentimentaux qui comblent son sens pervers de l'autoridérision et lui permettent de vivre confortablement. Sa vie est réglée comme du papier à musique, il évite le contact humain hormis celui de Carol Connelly, une jeune mère célibataire, serveuse dans un restaurant où il prend ses repas.

programme.title: Pour Le Pire Et Pour Le Meilleur
programme.desc: Melvin Udall, un écrivain misanthrope, écrit à la chaîne des romans sentimentaux qui comblent son sens pervers de l'autoridérision et lui permettent de vivre confortablement. Sa vie est réglée comme du papier à musique, il évite le contact humain hormis celui de Carol Connelly, une jeune mère célibataire, serveuse dans un restaurant où il prend ses repas.

programme.title: Step Brothers
programme.desc: Deux garçons gâtés l'un par sa mère, l'autre par son père, deviennent demi-frères quand leurs parents tombent amoureux et se marient.

programme.title: Témoin À Louer
programme.desc: Doug Harris a un vrai problème : le jeune homme, qui n'a pas une vie sociale très riche, est sur le point de se marier, mais n'a pas de témoin. Comme il ne lui reste que deux semaines pour en trouver un, il fait appel à Jimmy Callahan, patron d'une petite société qui se charge de fournir des entourages factices aux futurs mariés. Mais rien ne se passe comme prévu...

programme.title: Supernatural Activity
programme.desc: Dans une télé-réalité, Damon Dealer et son équipe de choc sont confrontés, chaque jour, à des phénomènes surnaturels. Cette fois-ci, ces enquêteurs sont sur la plus importante enquête paranormale : une chasse aux sorcières dans une maison hantée.

programme.title: Rosalie Blum
programme.desc: Vincent Machot connaît sa vie par cœur. Il la partage entre son salon de coiffure, son cousin, son chat, et sa mère bien trop envahissante. Mais la vie réserve parfois des surprises, même aux plus prudents... il croise par hasard Rosalie Blum...

programme.title: (S)ex List
programme.desc: Anna Faris et Chris Evans se partagent la vedette dans cette comédie sur une femme célibataire qui essaie de trouver le véritable amour en se lançant dans une recherche hilarante pour trouver le meilleur ex-petit ami de sa vie.

programme.title: Un plan d'enfer
programme.desc: Trois gardes de sécurité d'un prestigieux musée conçoivent un plan rocambolesque pour voler les tableaux auxquels ils sont devenus très attachés avant leur transfert vers un autre musée.

programme.title: Le trésor du lac d'argent
programme.desc: Le chef apache Winnetou et le trappeur Old Shatterhand poursuivent une bande de hors-la-loi meurtriers, prêts à tout pour mettre la main sur le légendaire trésor du Lac d'Argent.

programme.title: Texas, adios
programme.desc: Un shérif texan et son jeune frère traversent la frontière mexicaine pour affronter l'homme qui a tué leur père.

programme.title: Bianco Apache
programme.desc: Des hors-la-loi attaquent un groupe de colons et tuent tout le monde, sauf une femme enceinte qui est sauvée par une bande d'Indiens.

programme.title: L'homme du Minnesota
programme.desc: Emprisonné à tort pour un crime qu'il n'a pas commis, Minnesota Clay cherche à se venger de l'homme qui a dissimulé des preuves lors de son procès. Le hic : il devient aveugle.

programme.title: Arizona Colt
programme.desc: Le bandit Gordo libère un groupe de prisonniers, les obligeant à rejoindre son gang ou à mourir.

programme.title: Macho Callaghan se déchaîne
programme.desc: Un tireur solitaire traque les membres d'un gang de hors-la-loi qui a tué ses amis.

programme.title: Un dollar entre les dents
programme.desc: Un pistolero solitaire tente de conclure un marché avec un bandit mexicain pour se partager un chargement d'or volé, ce qui donne lieu à un jeu de trahisons sans merci entre les deux hommes.

programme.title: Une longue file de croix
programme.desc: Django et Santana sont des chasseurs de primes qui éliminent les bandits dans une petite ville de l'Ouest. Un propriétaire foncier malfaisant qui fait passer clandestinement des immigrants illégaux et les hommes qui travaillent pour lui ont une prime très élevée sur leur tête. Il est donc logique que Django et Santana viennent bientôt leur rendre visite.

programme.title: La mort était au rendez-vous
programme.desc: Un jeune tireur forme une alliance ténue avec un ancien hors-la-loi vieillissant pour traquer et éliminer les bandits qui ont tué sa famille, jusqu'à la fin surprenante.

programme.title: Le roi des Rats
programme.desc: Un groupe de rats mutants attaque des êtres humains.

programme.title: 400 Days
programme.desc: Quatre astronautes sont envoyés en mission scientifique de simulation pour tester les effets psychologiques des voyages dans l'espace. Enfermés durant 400 jours dans un simulateur , l'état mental de l'équipage se détériore lorsque qu'ils perdent toute communication avec le monde extérieur.

programme.title: Bloody Sand
programme.desc: Lors d'une apocalypse zombie, une femme au passé trouble originaire de Las Vegas se retrouve acculée dans le désert avec un zombie solitaire et affamé à ses trousses.

programme.title: Mort En Direct
programme.desc: Le soldat Wyatt Maddox se rend à la maison à l'enterrement de son petit frère pour constater que sa mort n'était pas aussi simple que la police le voudrait. Avec l'aide de Tara, le partenaire en ligne de son frère, il se met à résoudre le mystère sans savoir a quel point l'entreprise est insidieuse

programme.title: Pandemic
programme.desc: Dans un futur proche ravagé par un virus mondial, l'humanité est au bord de l'extinction alors que les infectés surpassent en nombre les non-infectés. La Dr Lauren (Rachel Nichols), une médecin déterminée, se rend à Los Angeles après la chute de New York pour diriger une équipe de secours.

programme.title: Myn Bala, Les Guerriers de la Steppe
programme.desc: Kazakhstan, 1729. Les Dzungars, une tribu de Mongols, avance rapidement à travers les Steppes.

programme.title: Vikingdom : L'Eclipse de Sang
programme.desc: Eirick combattra de l'enfer et de l'au-delà afin de récupérer un artéfact mythique.

programme.title: Présentation du film Le Renard Caché
programme.desc: Présentation du film Le Renard Caché

programme.title: Le Renard de l'Ombre
programme.desc: Hu Fei, le fils du maître d'armes Hu Yidao, doit venger la mort de son père en s'attaquant aux huit hommes malfaisants

programme.title: Le Pacte Du Mal
programme.desc: Diego, médecin endurci face à la douleur, est tenu pour responsable après la tentative de suicide de sa patiente Sara.

programme.title: Abandonnée
programme.desc: Marie hérite en Russie et découvre un double d'elle-même aux yeux vitreux.

programme.title: The Prey
programme.desc: Un peloton de soldats américains tombe dans une embuscade.

programme.title: The Lion Woman
programme.desc: Née couverte de poils, Eva Arctander lutte contre le rejet et transforme sa différence en force.

programme.title: Le Trésor Englouti
programme.desc: Naufragés en mer de Chine méridionale, deux hommes découvrent un royaume englouti.

programme.title: The Rage
programme.desc: Une épidémie de rage se déclare dans la taïga russe.

programme.title: Rottweiler
programme.desc: Laissé pour mort, un chien particulièrement féroce est réanimé et transformé par les laboratoires de l'armée en véritable cyborg.

programme.title: L'attentat
programme.desc: À Tel Aviv, un chirurgien découvre un lourd secret sur sa femme après un attentat.

programme.title: Ed Kemper, portrait d'un Serial Killer

programme.title: Why We Should Abolish Politicians

As trust in politicians reaches historic lows across Britain, Europe and the United States, Landemore makes the case that elections alone may no longer be enough to produce governments that truly represent ordinary people.

programme.title: Who Broke Britain's Energy System?
programme.desc: Arthur Downing, an energy expert, discusses his book Power and the People, which charts the history of British energy and how the system became broken.

programme.title: When Hasan Piker Met Jeremy Corbyn
programme.desc: Jeremy Corbyn is no stranger to media and political pile-ons. Neither is Hasan Piker. Hasan was due to meet Corbyn, the former leader of the Labour Party, but the UK government revoked his and his uncle Cenk Uygur's e-visas, claiming their arrival would not be "conducive to the public good." The interview proceeded regardless.

programme.title: We Teach Old People Gen Z Slang
programme.desc: A group of pensioners attempt to decode the mysterious and ever-evolving slang of Gen Z. From "gyatt" to "rage baiting", and "glizzy", these golden oldies give their unfiltered, often baffled, and always entertaining takes. Will they master the lingo or be left completely gobsmacked? Featuring genuine reactions, unexpected laughs, and a wholesome generational culture clash that's both cringe and heartwarming in equal measure.

programme.title: Trump's Greenland Deal Isn't What You Think
programme.desc: Ava is joined by Scott Lucas to break down the latest developments in Donald Trump's political moves. They discuss Trump's recent trip to New York where he met Andy Burnham face-to-face, and analyse the major story from the UN: the long-awaited "deal" on Greenland.

programme.title: Trump Will Lead To America's Downfall
programme.desc: Owen Jones makes his PolJOE debut to discuss Western decline and his book The Fall of the West. He examines economic, military, and moral crises, from Western support for Israel to Donald Trump and rising authoritarianism. Jones explores the legacy of Iraq, Afghanistan, and Libya, deindustrialisation, stagnant wages, and the financial crash, arguing that decades of concentrated wealth have led to decline.

programme.title: The Dark Money Behind Keir Starmer's Rise
programme.desc: Investigative journalist Peter Geoghegan discusses Labour Together, the organisation that shaped Keir Starmer's leadership project. Geoghegan explains how the group functioned less like a traditional thinktank and more like a political campaign machine backed by significant undeclared funding. That money, he argues, was used to build the polling, messaging, and strategy that underpinned Starmer's rise.

programme.title: The Grand Tour's Francis, Thomas & James Take On The British Test
programme.desc: Ahead of the brand new series of The Grand Tour on Prime, James Engelsman, Thomas Holland and Francis Bourgeois take on the ultimate test of Britishness, with tea making, cars, trains, cereal and plenty of questionable answers along the way.

programme.title: Stranger Things Cast Lift Lid On Final Ending & Much More
programme.desc: The Stranger Things cast including Finn Wolfhard, Caleb McLaughlin, Gaten Matarazzo, and Jamie Campbell Bower lift the lid on the final ending, debate their most iconic hairstyles, react to unexpected Vecna thirst traps and more. From hilarious cast banter to emotional reflections on the show's journey, this interview dives deep into the Upside Down one last time.

programme.title: Ultimate Quiz
programme.sub-title: Sienna Miller vs Nick Mohammed vs Dominic West
programme.desc: Sienna Miller, Dominic West and Nick Mohammed go head-to-head in the JOE Pub Quiz. The cast of WAR put their careers and general TV and film knowledge to the test, taking on questions about some of their biggest roles and most memorable moments. From The Wire, Ted Lasso and Layer Cake to Burnt, WAR, G.I. Joe and The Affair, do they know their famous lines, recognise the iconic images and remember the details from their own careers?

programme.title: Wonderful Wetlands
programme.desc: Water is the key to life. It provides a haven for countless plants and animals, everything from water-loving cats and predatory birds to killer dragonflies and carnivorous foliage. It can be a nursery, a migration stopover and a larder. And there's place where water is gathered, drained and stored for all to enjoy – the wetland. Wetlands are some of the most remarkable ecosystems in the natural world everything from dragonflies and bats to fish and amphibians can thrive thanks to the wonderful wetland.

programme.title: Extinction! Going, Going, Gone
programme.desc: Extinction, a daunting and confusing word. A force of nature, that sees the end of species, but also heralds the birth of others. Right now the extinction rate could be as much as 10,000 times faster than it should be. 20% of fish, a fifth of all reptiles and a quarter of mammals face extinction. If we are to do anything to stem the tide of extinction we must understand the lifestyles of those in danger. The future for countless animals is uncertain, but one thing is for sure – we have a lot to learn.

Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

For the area's water-dependent zebra, the Boteti River on the western edge of the pans is a dry-season lifeline. However, it is also a death trap, with lions waiting in ambush and crocodiles lurking in dark riverside caves.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: The vast Delta of the Mississippi River is the gateway to the South of the United States. It always has been. This is where our journey begins: through Louisiana along the banks of the mighty river, to the big inland city of New Orleans, founded long ago by the French. Further inland, sugarcane plantations and the villas of their former owners stretch as far as the eye can see. To the north, we leave the river and, taking spectacular roads, we pass through the swamplands of the Mississippi, which were once impenetrable, serving as the ideal hideout for many a runaway. Bordering Texas, where the swamplands end, is the beginning of the vast cattle country. This is home to the last remaining cowboys in the United States who, still today, maintain their French cultural heritage.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: The Great Lakes are among the most mythical landscapes of North America: endless water, endless forest. Many Native American peoples lived there later European settlers followed on the heels of the white hunters and trappers. They hunted in the forests and transported their furs and other goods across the water to the south where a small river situated at the southern tip of Lake Michigan flows onward towards the southern states. The settlement that sprung up there was called Checagou by the Indians. Much later, the settlement was to be the first skyscraper city in the world: Chicago, the megacity on the Great Lake.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

After an epic battle of elemental powers, Kai steals the last one from Karlof, who is kicked out of the tournament through a trap door leading to the unknown. Later that night, the Ninja go in search for Zane but come across an underground temple where Chen and his Anacondrai Worshippers steal Karlof's power. Is this a fighting tournament, or a ploy to steal everyone's power?

Lastly, Nya sees Zane's beacon is working again and is on the hunt for them.

programme.title: Ghost Story

Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, leaving them to crash. When the dust settles, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja. They discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. In order to save Lloyd and get their powers back, they set off to find the first clue – the scroll to the lost martial art of ‘Airjitzu'. On their way to get it, they have a run in with one of Moro's ghost generals Wraythe, and discover water is the key to stopping them. Meanwhile, Nya discovers a family secret – her mother was a Water Ninja and with training, she could be one too.

programme.title: Saturday Knight Fever
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters catching a cold means trouble for the NEXO-Knights when he can create an entirely new kind of “snotty” monster. King and Queen Halbert have journeyed to the town of Cleanington to open the brand new Scrubbery Barn at the invitation of Roger the Scrubber (seen in 104.) Meanwhile, the Book of Monsters drags Jestro to Snottingham – one of the coldest places in Knighton where everyone coughs, has a runny nose and is generally under-the-weather. The BOM demands that Jestro feed him a “snotheiser” ball which will probably make him sick. The BOM explains that if he is sick, he may just produce a whole new breed of magical monsters … some that the knights would NEVER expect. The BOM gets sick and starts coughing up phlegm globlins and bloblins. The Knights arrive, alerted to what they think is an attack on the town by Snottingham's mayor, Hack Coughmeier. The sickened, sneezy, snotty monsters infect the knights and, more importantly, the knights' NEXO-Shields. Now their NEXO-Powers are infected. As they try to download something to fight the monsters, they realize the powers they get are off strange, infected versions of their powers. The knights drive Jestro and his snot monsters off and they turn in for the night. And, overnight, they all get sick. Meanwhile, the BOM order a nice, hot lava bath…he'll feel fine by morning. But the knights wake-up with colds and they feel terrible. Ava and Merlok 2.0 thinks it will pass in a day or two…it's just a typical Snottingham cold. Each knight gets sick in their own funny way and their illnesses play right into Jestro and the BOM's hands: they're headed to Cleanington to kidnap the king! The citizens of the ultra-clean city hate the sight of monsters, but then feel caught in between when the sick, sneezy, snotty knights arrive on their Fortrex. The fight goes terribly for the knights. They try to download the Nexo-power “Glorious Griffon” but instead get just feathers. So they improvise and tickle the monsters! Ava finally comes up with a way to use some anti-virus tools on their NEXO-Shields and just as Jestro is about to take the king and queen away, the NEXO-Knights get their normal powers back! They defeat Jestro and save the king and queen.

programme.title: Open Mike Knight
programme.desc: The Book of Betrayal leads Jestro and his Monsters to Funnyton – the funnies town in the kingdom. When they Knights arrive to capture him, they discover (to their shock) that Jestro and the Book of Monsters are now the town's top comedians! Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton. But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody's in town. Then, they hear…laughter?! The entire town is there listening to a stand-up comic JOKES KNIGHTLY. He's hilarious. He commands such power, such attention, and such loyalty. Jestro and the BOM decide they must become funny. They order all kinds of book on comedy from Spamazon: books on parody, irony, insult humor, slapstick, satire, knock-knock jokes, elephant jokes, “my monster is so fat” jokes, etc. They work-up a ventriloquist act with the BOM sitting on Jestro's lap. They start doing their act and, surprisingly, they're funny. They're very funny. The Fortrex arrives and the knights rush out, ready for battle. They fight through a string of monsters just outside the town, but discover they're only working as “bouncers” to keep too many people out of the comedy club. (“Sorry, you guys aren't on the list.”) The knights hear loud laughs and head there. In the club, they discover the town isn't being held hostage, they're in the show voluntarily having a great time. And…Jestro and the BOM are funny. Meanwhile, during the show, Jokes Knightly decides he'll steal the BOM and Jestro's act. During the intermission at the comedy show, Clay comes backstage to talk to Jestro. Maybe, Clay says, this shows that Jestro doesn't have to be bad…he is funny, like Clay always said he was. Meanwhile, Jokes Knightly steals the BOM and Jestro can't find it. He panics. Clay encourages him…go on stage alone, be funny…he can do it! Jestro goes out and is funny on his own he hits all his punchlines, he gets big laughs he starts to see that Clay is right. The BOM sees that Jokes Knightly has a “joke book” that turns out to be the BOOK OF BETRAYAL. That's how Mike Knight has become so funny – by stealing everyone's material! BOM calls in Magmar, who saves him from Mike Knight AND takes the Book of Betrayal. As Jestro comes off-stage to great applause, the BOM tells him they have the Book of Betrayal. The BOM calls in Magmar and his monsters and they start a fight as Clay comes to Jestro's defense and calls on the other Knights for backup. A big battle ensues that destroys the comedy club in Funnyton. The Knights win and drive-off Magmar, the monsters and the BOM. As they retreat, the BOM looks around: “Where's my Jestro?!” Jestro sneaked away during the fight and is in a nearby forest with…the Book of Betrayal.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: The New Detectives: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: Handwriting Analysis- We've all heard that our handwriting tells more about our personalities than we think. Are we risk-takers, have low-esteem, fun loving, or are we capable of murder? While our handwriting may not reveal the nuances of our personalities, the dotting of the 'i's and crossing of the 't's is an important business in criminal investigation. Apparent suicide notes, letters from suspected offenders and signatures are scrutinized down to the last dot. Handwriting comparisons can tell if the victim really did sign that new life insurance policy, or if the person who had everything to live for actually wrote the eloquent suicide note.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Death Shift
programme.desc: An unassuming male nurse from Kentucky comes under scrutiny when hospital officials notice that death is unusually prominent during his work shifts. In fact, death seemed to follow Donald Harvey from job to job, beginning in 1970 and ending with his arrest in 1987. Harvey – probably the most prolific serial murderer in the nation's history – claimed to have murdered his ailing charges out of compassion, but his meticulous diary, 30 pounds of cyanide, and a witch's brew of dangerous drugs discovered in his home pointed to darker motives. And his quiet rampage would have likely continued, if not for the vigilant coroner who decided to investigate further the odd smell of almonds coming from his fresh corpse.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.28
programme.desc: Mun Saseung is appointed as the new nangcheong of the Bunwon, and Jeongi becomes the first female master potter in Joseon history. Seeing Jeongi clad in her official potter's robes, Gwanghae smiles with pride and gifts her the workshop once used by Euldam. Reduced to desperation, Gangcheon and Yukdo beg Mun Saseung to allow them to remain at the Bunwon. Elsewhere, at the request of a Japanese merchant, Hwa-ryeong summons Jeongi—hinting at new trials yet to come.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.29
programme.desc: To protect Jeongi, Gwanghae arranges for a personal guard to stay by her side. When pigments needed for overglaze painting run short, Mun Saseung turns to Hwa-ryeong for supplies—drawing Gangcheon straight to her. Thanks to Jeongi's foresight in testing Gangcheon's scheme in advance, Mun Saseung successfully completes the tribute porcelain. Enraged by his failure, Gangcheon orders Mapung to kill Jeongi.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.30
programme.desc: After hearing the full truth from Mapung, Jeongi breaks down in tears before Mun Saseung, who is left stunned and shaken. Jeongi then pleads with Gwanghae to delay Gangcheon's arrest just a little longer. Confronting Gangcheon herself, Jeongi is devastated once more when he coldly declares that Yukdo is the only bloodline he acknowledges. Claiming he wishes to atone, Gangcheon summons Jeongi to Euldam's grave.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.31
programme.desc: Tailing Hwa-ryeong's men from the merchant guild, Taedo discovers the kiln where Jeongi is being held. Seizing a brief opening as soldiers pass by, he rescues Jeongi and flees with her—only to be struck by a throwing blade. Face to face with Gangcheon, Jeongi unleashes her fury, declaring that she can never forgive him for being her father. Steeling her resolve, Jeongi immerses herself in the potter's wheel and presents the finished vessel to King Seonjo.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.32
programme.desc: With the Bunwon seized by Japanese forces, Jeongi attempts to slip away to meet Gwanghae but is captured by Gangcheon. After learning the full truth from Mun Saseung, Yukdo agonizes over his choice—then ultimately releases Jeongi. Trusting that Gwanghae will drive the invaders away, Jeongi returns to the Bunwon and waits for his promise to be fulfilled.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA

programme.title: Myths
programme.sub-title: The Greatest Mysteries of Humanity - The Treasure of the Nibelung
programme.desc: Germany's most famous legend, The Nibelungs, still fascinates modern treasure hunters. They're on a quest to find Siegfried's legendary gold using old texts and divining rods. This mythical treasure, supposedly resting in the Rhine, includes gold, silver, and even a magical cloak that makes the wearer invisible.What's the scoop behind this legend? Scientists are on the case to trace its roots. The journey takes them to Scandinavia where an archaeologist searches for some of the saga's earliest signs. Meanwhile, a blacksmith is trying to recreate Siegfried's sword using ancient techniques, putting it to the test. They've even found bones that help explain the dragon part of the myth. Historians and language experts offer insights into who the Nibelungs were and what the treasure could have looked like.

programme.title: Myths: The Greatest Mysteries of Humanity
programme.desc: When Howard Carter's team found King Tut's tomb in 1922, they became famous but paid a big price. Over the next ten years, 17 people linked to the discovery died under strange circumstances. Many are convinced there's only one reason for this: the Pharaoh's curse, meant for anyone who dares to mess with the king's resting place. Old clay tablets show that ancient Egyptians often used spells. It's believed a curse was also put on Tutankhamun's tomb to guard his legendary treasures.Tutankhamun's tomb in the Valley of the Kings is one of the biggest archaeological finds ever. Some people think the discovery triggered a string of mysterious deaths - could the tomb be cursed?

programme.title: Missing Link

programme.title: Eternal Pompeii
programme.desc: This documentary reveals what followed Pompeii's destruction, from Emperor Titus' crisis response to reconstruction, recovery, and exploitation—offering lessons on managing disasters.

programme.title: World War II
programme.desc: July 1944: Operation Cobra aims to break out of Normandy. Veterans recall brutal hedgerow fighting, Patton's rapid advance, the liberation of Paris, the German defeat at Falaise, and the failed plot to assassinate Hitler.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: The new Mercedes-Benz GLC AMG Line World Premiere Teaser
programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. This adds striking design features and enhances the unique proportions of the vehicle. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Robert Jewell explores recipes using two very different ingredients that start with the letter "O," oats and okra. For his first dish, Robert uses okra in a classic cornmeal cake recipe, but bumps up the flavour factor with spicy jalapenos. Robert balances the heat of the jalapeno with a tart green tomato and crunchy red onion salsa. In his next recipe, Robert keeps the heat, but switches up his recipes for a curry-spiced oat pancake. This Indian inspired dish needs something to cool it down and Robert knows exactly what that is - sweet, silky applesauce! He's up for the challenge when it comes to combining okra and oats into one dish, and the results are tasty!

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: It's all about beautiful butter in this episode of Watts on the Grill! First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. Next up is a traditional Indian recipe, but done on the grill - Butter Chicken! All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving day!

Decide, quindi, di inoltrarsi nelle foreste selvagge della Birmania per fuggire ai controlli e continuare il suo reportage. Qui, viene catturato da un gruppo di indigeni che vivono allo stato brado. Costretto a lavorare per loro, si innamorerà, alla fine, di Maraya, figlia del capo tribù.

programme.title: Una Moglie Americana

programme.title: Splendor

programme.title: Rappresaglia
programme.desc: Roma 23 Marzo 1944. Le truppe tedesche tengono la città sotto il loro controllo. In seguito ad un attentato contro una compagnia delle SS compiuto in via Rasella, il generale Maelzer informa i suoi capi a Berlino che, decisi ad abrogare qualunque soglia di tolleranza, ordinano una veloce rappresaglia, pretendendo l`esecuzione di dieci italiani per ogni tedesco ucciso. Sarà il tenente colonnello Herbert Kapller a gestire l`intervento e a compilare la lista dei sacrificati, nonostante il suo aperto dissenso.

programme.title: Allonsanfan
programme.desc: 1816. Nell`Europa della Restaurazione, Fulvio Imbriani, un prigioniero politico aristocratico, ex giacobino ed ex ufficiale napoleonico, esce dal carcere e fa ritorno alla proprietà di famiglia. I suoi ex compagni di lotta fanno di tutto per coinvolgerlo nuovamente in azioni rivoluzionarie, ma lui è riluttante e sfiduciato. Finché si butta a capofitto in una rovinosa spedizione al Sud...

programme.title: Ciao maschio

programme.title: Prima danza e poi pensa

programme.title: Ribalta di gloria

Dopo una serie di azioni autodistruttive, Alice dovrà andare oltre e riallacciare i rapporti con il ragazzo che ama.

programme.desc: Alla vigilia del matrimonio di suo figlio, Lynn, una donna che ha sempre nascosto le sue emozioni, insieme ai suoi tre figli dovrà fare i conti con le montagne russe emotive di una riunione di famiglia. Una commedia oscura con Ellen Barkin e Demi Moore.

programme.title: Love shooting
programme.desc: Charlie è un produttore cinematografico che si lascia convincere a realizzare un film su Benjamin Disraeli, a patto che il protagonista sia un attore di grande fama che però verrà rapito, costringendo Charlie ad escogitare una soluzione creativa.

programme.title: Lamore non basta
programme.desc: Martina è un'assistente di volo. Durante un volo conosce Angelo, un ragazzo timido e introverso che come lei vive in un piccolo paese dell'Abruzzo. Scopriranno invece di conoscersi da molto tempo.

programme.title: Guerra al virus
programme.desc: America anni '80. Il dottor Francis è uno dei primi a scoprire il virus dell'Hiv, ma la società americana rimane indifferente alla malattia considerandola pericolosa solo per gli omosessuali.

programme.title: Gun Shy: Eroe per caso
programme.desc: Turk Henry, bassista di una band di successo che si è recentemente sciolta, parte con la moglie per una vacanza di lusso esotica in Cile. Quando la donna viene rapita da un gruppo di banditi, Turk è costretto a rimboccarsi le maniche e a inoltrarsi in una pericolosa missione di salvataggio.

programme.title: Mortdecai
programme.desc: Alle prese con alcuni russi arrabbiati, con l'MI5 inglese, con sua moglie e con un terrorista internazionale, il disinvolto trafficante d'arte e piccola canaglia Charlie Mortdecai deve attraversare il mondo armato solo della sua bellezza e del suo fascino mentre cerca di recuperare un quadro rubato.

programme.title: Giovani ribelli
programme.desc: La vera storia mai raccontata di quattro giovani studenti della Columbia University che ispirati dall'esempio di Walt Whitman e della "setta dei poeti estinti" sfidarono le rigide regole della più potente Università Americana.

programme.title: Maps to the stars
programme.desc: La famiglia Weiss ha fatto dell'ossessione per la celebrità il proprio marchio distintivo.

programme.title: Grace is Gone
programme.desc: Un padre vedovo porta le figlie in viaggio prima di dir loro la verità

programme.title: Beastly
programme.desc: Bello e arrogante, Kyle viene trasformato in un “mostro”. Solo l'amore vero potrà salvarlo. Una favola dark dove l'apparenza non conta più.

programme.title: Daybreakers L'ultimo vampiro
programme.desc: Un'epidemia ha trasformato quasi tutti gli umani in vampiri, costringendo i pochi superstiti a nascondersi. Edward Dalton, un vampiro che rifiuta il sangue umano, lavora per creare un'alternativa sintetica e salvare l'umanità con l'aiuto della sopravvissuta Audrey.

programme.title: Hansel e Gretel e La Strega Della Foresta Nera
programme.desc: I fratelli Hansel e Gretel, abbandonati nel bosco, finiscono nella casa di una strega che intende cucinarli. I due riescono non solo a fuggire ma anche ad uccidere la strega. Quest'episodio trasforma la loro vita, che da quel momento in poi i due decidono di dedicare alla lotta alle streghe.

programme.title: La casa del diavolo
programme.desc: Sequel del sanguinoso 'La casa dei mille corpi', la psicotica famiglia Firefly vaga senza meta, lasciando sulla strada una scia di morte e distruzione. È, però, braccata da uno sceriffo feroce e due cacciatori di taglie senza scrupoli: la caccia sarà spietata.

programme.title: 12 sfide di Natale
programme.desc: Un'insegnante accetta una sfida natalizia composta da dodici prove mentre prepara la sua città per un programma di scambio, ritrovandosi sempre più vicina a un affascinante collega.

programme.title: L'ereditiera del Natale
programme.desc: L'erede di un grande magazzino viene messa alla prova dalla nonna e costretta a lavorare durante il periodo più intenso dell'anno, scoprendo il vero valore del Natale.

programme.title: Le scarpe magiche di Natale
programme.desc: Bloccata in un grande magazzino alla vigilia di Natale, una donna incontra una misteriosa guida che attraverso un paio di scarpe magiche le mostra possibilità diverse per la propria vita.

programme.title: Vote for Santa
programme.desc: Due fratelli si trovano su fronti opposti quando la Fabbrica del Natale deve essere modernizzata contro il volere di Babbo Natale, mentre gli amici animati dell'Artico complicano la situazione.

programme.title: Un Natale quasi perfetto
programme.desc: Una giovane coppia invita entrambe le famiglie per il primo Natale insieme, ma una gravidanza inattesa e un licenziamento trasformano le feste in una prova di sincerità.

programme.title: Rapita
programme.desc: Nuova nei sobborghi, Jessica fa amicizia con il suo strano vicino, ma presto si ritrova bloccata nel suo rifugio sotterraneo in stile anni '50.

programme.title: Una Reginetta pericolosa
programme.desc: Dylan viene trasferita in una nuova scuola dopo che sua madre è stata ricoverata in un centro di riabilitazione per abuso di antidolorifici. Dopo uno scontro con la ragazza più temuta della scuola, Tiffany, quest'ultima comincia a pianificare come trasformare la vita di Dylan in un vero inferno.

programme.title: Degrees of Fear
programme.desc: Un anno dopo essere sopravvissuta a un brutale rapimento, Dakota si rende conto di essere nuovamente vittima di stalking. Ora, temendo per la propria vita ma determinata a non essere più vittima, Dakota decide di smascherare il suo tormentatore.

programme.title: Nella rete del killer
programme.desc: La stella del calcio Jenna Sims e sua madre Sally sono pronte per un nuovo inizio quando si trasferiscono in una nuova e soleggiata città sulla spiaggia. Ma quando gli altri membri della sua nuova squadra di calcio iniziano a morire e uno finisce in coma, Jenna si trova accusata del crimine.

programme.title: Qui dove batte il cuore
programme.desc: Una diciassettenne incinta ricostruisce la propria vita dopo essere stata abbandonata dal suo ragazzo in un Walmart a Sequoyah, in Oklahoma.

programme.title: Sesso, bugie... e difetti di fabbrica
programme.desc: Angela è un'ambiziosa donna d'affari che lavora per un boss molto esigente, e che deve vedersela col marito Curtis e, soprattutto, con un'inaspettata gravidanza che le creerà non pochi problemi sul lavoro e nella vita privata.

programme.title: Chiedi alla polvere
programme.desc: A Los Angeles della Grande Depressione si incontrano lo scrittore Arturo e la cameriera Camilla. Lui sogna di scrivere un romanzo, lei di sposare un uomo ricco e cambiare le sue umili sorti. Diversi per estrazione etnica e culturale, finiranno per innamorarsi in maniera del tutto inaspettata.

programme.title: Escobar: Paradise Lost
programme.desc: Nick pensa di aver trovato il paradiso quando raggiunge il fratello in Colombia. Una laguna turchese, una spiaggia d'avorio, onde perfette - è un sogno per questo giovane surfista canadese. Poi incontra Maria, una splendida ragazza colombiana.

programme.title: Il sole è anche una stella
programme.desc: Un romantico universitario e una pragmatica giamaicana si incontrano, e si innamorano, in una magica giornata a New York, in questa storia d'amore dei nostri giorni...

programme.title: Breaking Up
programme.desc: Il fotografo in difficoltà Steve e l'insegnante Monica scoprono l'eccitante amore di una vita che tutti sognano.

programme.title: Half Nelson
programme.desc: Ryan Gosling è Dan, un insegnante di una scuola pubblica brillante e capace di motivare i suoi allievi. Ma giunta la sera vive un profondo tormento interiore che lo porta a consumare la sua esistenza nell'abuso di alcool e droghe. Sarà la nascita dell'amicizia con un'allieva a cambiare tutto.

programme.title: Pig
programme.desc: Rob (Nicolas Cage) è un ex grande chef ritiratosi nelle terre selvagge dell'Oregon. E' un uomo solitario, un cacciatore di tartufi accompagnato soltanto dal suo amato maiale.

programme.title: Le scarpe magiche di Natale
programme.desc: Noelle, che detesta il Natale, resta bloccata in un grande magazzino alla Vigilia. Qui incontra una donna che sostiene di essere il suo angelo custode e le fa vivere una esperienza simile a quella raccontata da 'Canto di natale' di Charles Dickens.

programme.title: Uno chef per Natale
programme.desc: Quando l'ambiziosa corrispondente gastronomica, CARLY HAYES, ha la possibilità di realizzare un suo show, nulla va come previsto. Viene mandata ad Angel Heights per aiutare GRANT QUINN, uno chef perfezionista e timido, a riaprire l'amato ristorante della sua famiglia e filmarlo come pilota speciale natalizio per il suo programma televisivo. Grant non riaprirà solo il suo ristorante, ma molto probabilmente anche il suo cuore!

programme.title: Un amore da ricordare
programme.desc: Tenley trova finalmente il coraggio di incontrare dal vivo Jared, conosciuto online un anno prima. Quando questi ha un incidente, l'ospedale fa firmare i documenti a Tenley, facendo credere alla famiglia di Jared che i due siano sposati.

programme.title: Il sapore del Natale
programme.desc: Scarlett è un'incredibile chef e comproprietaria di un ristorante di fascia alta. Ma ogni anno i suoi piatti festivi, troppo sofisticati e unici, non si vendono mai: semplicemente non mettono le persone nello spirito natalizio! Quindi quest'anno, la sua migliore amica e comproprietaria le compra un biglietto per una vacanza culinaria in una bellissima villa... dove Scarlett imparerà di nuovo la cucina festiva da zero, magari troverà l'amore in un affascinante chef rivale del suo passato e riconquisterà lo spirito natalizio di cui il suo cibo e la sua vita hanno veramente bisogno.

programme.title: Dopo luragano
programme.desc: La vita di un giovanissimo cuoco viene travolta dall'arrivo dell'uragano Sandy nel 2012. Il giovane deve ricostruire il ristorante di famiglia, completamente distrutto, ma incontra sulla propria strada un mecenate che crede in lui e l'amore.

programme.title: The Congress
programme.desc: Robin Wright, una ormai stanca e invecchiata diva hollywoodiana, accetta un ultimo ruolo offertole dalla major Miramount, che le propone di comprare la sua identità cinematografica: attraverso un body scanner verrà creato un alias a sua immagine da utilizzare sullo schermo al posto suo, rendendola così protagonista di tutti i film che in passato lei stessa aveva rifiutato. In cambio Robin riceverà un'ingente somma di denaro e gli studios le promettono di mantenere il suo personaggio giovane per l'eternità.

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Annie vive una relazione abitudinaria con Duncan, fan ossessivo dell'ormai sconosciuto musicista rock Tucker Crowe. Un incontro con l'elusivo rocker che cambierà la vita di tutti i protagonisti.

programme.title: SWOP
programme.desc: Dopo aver fatto l'amore insieme per la prima volta durante una selvaggia notte al college, Lainey e Jake si separano. I loro cammini si incrociano nuovamente anni dopo ed entrambi si rendono conto che quella debosciata serata ha avuto effetti drastici sulle rispettive vite sessuali: mentre Jake è divenuto un donnaiolo, Lainey è sempre bloccata con la persona sbagliata. Nonostante si sforzino di tenere a freno il desiderio che hanno l'uno per l'altra, Lainey e Jake realizzano presto che la loro esplosiva intesa potrebbe essere la risposta a tutti i loro problemi se solo potessero smettere di dormire con altra gente.

programme.title: Il Segreto del suo Volto
programme.desc: Giugno 1945. Ferita, con il volto sfigurato, sopravvissuta ad Auschwitz, Nelly torna a Berlino. Guarita a malapena dall'intervento chirurgico al volto, la donna cerca il marito Johnny, l'amore della sua vita. Quando casualmente Nelly ritrova Johnny, lui non la riconosce. L'intervento l'ha resa quasi irriconoscibile. Eppure notando in lei una vaga somiglianza con la moglie, le chiede di assumerne l'identità, sperando così di mettere le mani sull'eredità della famiglia di lei. Nelly accetta. Vuole capire se Johnny l'ama ancora o se l'ha tradita, come sostiene la sua amica. Nelly rivuole la sua vita.

programme.title: Dopo l'amore
programme.desc: Marie e Boris, dopo quindici anni di matrimonio, vivono separati in casa a causa di difficoltà economiche e per il bene delle figlie. Questo dramma contemporaneo esplora i paradossi e le sfide di una relazione che si sgretola lentamente.

programme.title: Jellyfish
programme.desc: Tra il bullismo a scuola, le angherie del suo prepotente capo alla sala giochi locale e il dover badare al fratello minore, alla sorella e alla madre maniaco-depressiva, la vita di Sarah Taylor non è facile. Mentre il suo amore per la commedia cresce e la vetrina si avvicina, il delicato equilibrio della sua vita diventa sempre più difficile da mantenere...

programme.title: Parlami Di Te
programme.desc: Alain è un uomo d'affari che non concede alcuno spazio alle distrazioni e alla famiglia. Viene colpito da un ictus, che gli lascia una grave difficoltà nell'espressione verbale e una perdita della memoria. Si affida a una giovane logopedista.

programme.title: Tutto Ciò che Voglio
programme.desc: Wendy è Autistica, viene aiutata dalla terapia della struttura specializzata di Scottie, proteggendo la sua rigida routine quotidiana e permettendo che la ragazza coltivi la sua passione, ovvero la visione della saga televisiva Star Trek.

programme.title: Tutte le ex del mio ragazzo
programme.desc: Brittany Murphy catturerà il vostro cuore in questo divertentissimo film su una brava ragazza che non ne combina una giusta. Assunta per lavorare in un talk show televisivo, la vita di Stacy Holt è stravolta quando viene convinta ad esplorare uno dei temi del programma e controlla l'agenda del suo ragazzo. Ma si è dimenticata una cosa: nel mondo della TV, c'è sempre una sorpresa scioccante dietro l'angolo -- e lei ne avrà una bella grande!

programme.title: Tutte le ex del mio ragazzo
programme.desc: Brittany Murphy catturerà il vostro cuore in questo divertentissimo film su una brava ragazza che non ne combina una giusta. Assunta per lavorare in un talk show televisivo, la vita di Stacy Holt è stravolta quando viene convinta ad esplorare uno dei temi del programma e controlla l'agenda del suo ragazzo. Ma si è dimenticata una cosa: nel mondo della TV, c'è sempre una sorpresa scioccante dietro l'angolo -- e lei ne avrà una bella grande!

programme.title: Suxbad: 3 Menti Sopra Il Pelo
programme.desc: Due inseparabili ragazzi del liceo vogliano agganciare delle ragazze prima di diplomarsi e frequentare college diversi, ma dopo una notte disastrosa trascorsa nel tentativo di acquistare alcoolici, superare la loro ansietà causata dalla separazione diventerà una sfida maggiore della conquista delle ragazze.

programme.title: Il Rompiscatole
programme.desc: Solitamente dando una mancetta di $50 al tecnico televisivo si possono vedere gratis tutti i canali desiderati. Ma quando Steven Kovacs (Matthew Broderick) trasloca, scopre che il tecnico della tv (Jim Carrey) è diverso. Non vuole i 50 verdoni, ma diventare amico di Steven.

programme.title: Mi faccia causa
programme.desc: Davanti al pretore Giovanni Pennisi transita tutti i giorni un campionario di varia umanità,

programme.title: Il paramedico
programme.desc: Mario vince un'auto, ma dopo un furto da parte dei terroristi finisce in carcere.

programme.title: Il magnate
programme.desc: Clara, moglie di Furio Cicerone, rifiuta il conte Arienti, ma intrighi finanziari mettono tutto a rischio

programme.title: Tre tigri contro tre tigri
programme.desc: Secondo film ad episodi dal cast vincente: Pozzetto, Cochi, Villaggio e Montesano

programme.title: Accadde al penitenziario
programme.desc: In un penitenziario, le disavventure di un gruppo di detenuti e delle loro relazioni con il personale, tra situazioni comiche e paradossali, creando un mix di risate e riflessioni sulla vita dietro le sbarre.

programme.title: Totò cerca casa
programme.desc: Totò è un uomo alla ricerca disperata di una casa, ma si trova coinvolto in una serie di situazioni esilaranti e complicate. Tra inganni e malintesi, il film esplora con ironia le difficoltà della vita quotidiana.

programme.title: Totò Sexy
programme.desc: Due suonatori ambulanti finiscono in carcere per contrabbando e si rifugiano in sogni popolati da donne seducenti e atmosfere esotiche. Una commedia musicale guidata dall'ironia inconfondibile di Totò, tra gag surreali e fantasia.

programme.title: Anni difficili
programme.desc: Con Umberto Spadaro, Massimo Girotti e Ave Ninchi, Aldo Piscitello deve aderire al Partito Fascista e affrontare la guerra. Tra doveri familiari e scelte morali, cerca il coraggio di restare fedele a sé stesso in un'Italia in crisi.

programme.title: Uncle Drew
programme.desc: Il giovane proprietario di una squadra e Uncle Drew (L'All-Star NBA Kyrie Irving) riuniscono la vecchia squadra di Drew per dimostrare che un gruppo di settuagenari può ancora vincere un grande torneo.

programme.title: The English Teacher
programme.desc: Linda Sinclair, quarantenne insegnante d inglese di un liceo della piccola cittadina di Kingston. La sua semplice vita, per, prende una piega inaspettata quando l ex allievo pupillo Jason Sherwood ritorna a Kingston dopo avere cercato di affermarsi come drammaturgo a New York.

programme.title: 2 matrimoni alla volta
programme.desc: La vita di Greg è diventata fin troppo tranquilla da quando ha chiuso l'agenzia specializzata nella creazione di alibi ad hoc e ha promesso a Flo una relazione priva di bugie e inganni. Ma come può mantenere la parola data quando Flo vuole conoscere la sua eccentrica famiglia in vista delle nozze?

programme.title: Comportamenti Molto Cattivi
programme.desc: Il sedicenne Rick Stevens non desidera altro che conquistare il cuore di Nina Pennington, la ragazza dei suoi sogni ed è pronto a tutto pur di riuscirci. Si ritroverà, però, coinvolto in una serie di avvenimenti del tutto fuori dagli schemi.

programme.title: Lettere A Giulietta
programme.desc: Una giovane giornalista americana parte per Verona, città dell'amore tra Giulietta e Romeo. Qui si unisce alle volontarie che rispondo alle lettere indirizzate a Giulietta, scritte dai cuori travagliati di tutto il mondo.

programme.title: James Tont Operazione D.U.E.
programme.desc: Un pericoloso gruppo criminale vuole distruggere la basilica di San Pietro seguendo un piano chiamato Operazione DUE, Distruzione Urbe Eterna. L'unico che può fermarli è l'agente segreto James Tont. Con il mitico Lando Buzzanca.

programme.title: Red Dog Linizio
programme.desc: In un villaggio di minatori arriva Red, un simpatico cane randagio dal pelo rosso diventa presto il beniamino del villaggio. Red stravolgerà la vita di tutti ma soprattutto quella di John con la quale instaurerà un rapporto d'amicizia speciale.

programme.title: Big Baby
programme.desc: Uno scienziato inventa una macchina che agisce sui geni e trasforma il nipote di quattro anni in un adulto. Quando Bobby scappa di casa, i suoi fratelli devono riuscire a trovarlo prima del ritorno dei genitori. Il tempo stringe, rimane un solo giorno!

programme.title: Irma Vep
programme.desc: Un' attrice cinematografica Cinese, in Francia per recitare in un remake di "Les Vampires", trova futili intrighi e vanitosi scontri sul set.

programme.title: Mamma mi sono persa il fratellino!
programme.desc: Quando i genitori partono per la Francia lasciandola col terribile fratellino, Kathy lo trasforma in un porcellino usando le pietre magiche della tata. La ragazza, però, finisce per pentirsene e fa di tutto per riuscire spezzare l'incantesimo.

programme.title: Solo contro Roma
programme.desc: Il console romano, dopo aver conquistato la città di Alesia, lascia a governare un suo Tribuno. Perfido e crudele, quest'ultimo commette a ogni tipo di nefandezze, arrivando a far arrestare il capo della città e sua figlia, Fabiola. Quando Brenno, il fidanzato di Fabiola viene condannato a morte, la città di Alesia si ribella.

programme.title: Ursus
programme.desc: Ursus torna dalla guerra e scopre che la sua fidanzata, Attea, è stata rapita. Parte alla sua ricerca, con Doreide, schiava cieca.

programme.title: Ercole al centro della Terra
programme.desc: Firmato da Mario Bava, Ercole scende negli inferi tra mostri e oscurità per salvare la donna amata in una sfida oltre la morte.

programme.title: La furia di Ercole
programme.desc: Tra magie oscure, battaglie e tradimenti, Ercole affronta forze nemiche per liberare il regno e salvare chi ama.

programme.title: Ercole contro Roma
programme.desc: Tra rivolte, tradimenti e scontri spettacolari, Ercole affronta Roma per difendere il suo popolo e ristabilire la giustizia.

programme.title: Prega il morto e ammazza il vivo
programme.desc: Dopo che Dan Hogan e la sua banda hanno rapinato una banca, assumono un uomo misterioso che li guidi attraverso il confine messicano in cambio di metà del bottino.

programme.title: Thompson 1880
programme.desc: Ray Thompson, giovane e indigente, raggiunge Desert Spring, portando una valigia in cima al suo mulo. Una banda guidata da Brady utilizza mezzi apparentemente legali per impedire a chiunque di commerciare e sfrutta per sé tutte le possibilità della città.

programme.title: All' ombra di una colt
programme.desc: Una storia su due pistoleri, Duke e Steve. Steve è innamorato della figlia di Duke.

programme.title: L'uomo dalla pistola d'oro
programme.desc: Doc McGregor, ex chirurgo diventato giocatore d'azzardo, è falsamente accusato di omicidio e braccato dal cacciatore di taglie Slade. In fuga, assume l'identità del defunto Larry Kitchener, senza sapere che era un temuto pistolero scelto come sceriffo per fermare Reyes, il bandito che terrorizza Baldosas.

programme.title: L'uomo della legge
programme.desc: Mike Ryan, un agente sotto copertura, assume il ruolo di vice sceriffo in una cittadina al confine con l'Arizona, perseguitata da rapine a diligenze. Dopo un colpo andato storto, il capo banda Velvet Clark scappa, mascherandosi da cittadino rispettabile. Ryan lo rintraccia a Gunsight Ridge per un duello finale.

programme.title: Ehi amico…c'è Sabata, hai chiuso!
programme.desc: Un abile pistolero sfida i leader di Daugherty per rubare $100.000 destinati alla ferrovia.

programme.title: Indio Black, sai che ti dico: Sei un gran figlio di…
programme.desc: Durante la rivoluzione messicana, il pistolero Sabata trama per rubare oro da un colonnello austriaco.

programme.title: Il segno del coyote
programme.desc: Per vendicare i torti ai messicani, il figlio di un barone si finge collaboratore, ma è El Coyote.

programme.title: 100.000 dollari per Lassiter
programme.desc: Martin è sfruttato dai banditi finché Lassiter non gli rivela il nascondiglio di colui che lo ha reso storpio.

programme.title: I sette del Texas
programme.desc: Il ricco texano Clifford, in viaggio per salvare la moglie, affronta minacce dai nativi.

programme.desc: La serie che celebra i grandi attori degli ultimi 90 anni.

programme.desc: Tutte le news che vi siete persi dalla redazione di HotCorn: tra ospiti, interviste e grandi novità al cinema.
